input: Find a local philately club for stamp collectors

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Stamp Collecting Club Nearby
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a philately club in their local area to connect with other stamp collectors.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow the search to relevant local clubs.

questions.title: Are you a beginner or an experienced collector?
questions.description: Understand the user's experience level to find a club that matches their background.

questions.title: Do you collect a specific type or era of stamps?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a niche focus that might require a specialist club.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to attend meetings?
questions.description: Establish a distance radius to filter clubs by practical accessibility.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person meetings or online club communities?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a physical club, a virtual one, or is open to both.

questions.title: What is your main goal for joining a club?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants to trade stamps, learn, socialise, or compete at shows.

questions.title: Is there a preferred meeting frequency, such as weekly or monthly?
questions.description: Match the user with clubs whose meeting schedule fits their availability.
